rationale: Colly is a high-performance Go web scraping framework providing explicit request queueing abstractions (queue/queue.go), thread synchronization, and HTML parsing hooks. While it lacks native browser rendering or self-healing capabilities, its request management and queueing interfaces directly map to the pipeline queue concern.
limitations: Lacks headless browser automation and JavaScript rendering support.
Does not contain built-in stealth evasion or advanced anti-bot dynamic solving.
No explicit architecture design documents found in the repository.
